# map3d

> **React 3D mapping library** (Three.js), published to npm (ESM + CJS + types).
> Photorealistic globe → flat map, DOM/CSS markers and clusters, ground-draped paths and
> shapes, Figma-style drawing editor, viewport-driven + real-time data, tag filtering,
> unified search, pedestrian mode, MIL-STD-2525D symbology — **fully themable and 100 %
> translatable** (no hard-coded text or values anywhere).

## Mental model (read this first)

- **Imperative engine driven by React**, not a component tree that owns state. `MapEngine`
  (three.js, camera, tiles, layer list) is the single source of truth; usable standalone,
  outside React. The React layer mounts it declaratively.
- **Single public entry point**: `import { … } from '@pasquelin/map3d'`. Everything is re-exported from
  `src/index.ts`. `VERSION` exposes the current version.
- **`<Map>` mounts every surface and layer internally** (bar, controls, cluster, catalog,
  pedestrian HUD, coordinate grid…), driven by `config`/`theme`/`labels`/props. Its `children`
  are for the host's OWN overlays only — you get a full map without putting anything there. Never
  require the host to child-mount a lib layer.
- **Three settings trees** provided by `<MapProvider>` (or `<Map>` directly): `theme` (visual
  identity — colors/sizes/rhythm; a **full** `MapTheme` or a `{ light, dark }` pair — build one with
  `mergeTheme(defaultTheme, partial)`), `labels` and `config` (language + units, `MapConfig` — API
  keys, quotas, gestures, budgets, support; both are **partials deep-merged** onto `defaultLabels` /
  `defaultConfig`). A component's props **override** these trees for a single instance.
- **Peer deps**: `react`/`react-dom` **19**, `three` **≥ 0.160**. Install:
  `npm i @pasquelin/map3d three react react-dom`.
- **Per-frame read/write separation**: layers run `update()` (advance the 3D — read pass) then
  `project()` (write DOM overlays in a single pass) — aim for zero allocation in the frame loop.
- **Photorealistic 3D**: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles via **Cesium Ion** (a single token,
  `VITE_CESIUM_ION_TOKEN` in the example), with an ellipsoid globe fallback when no token is
  set. The 2D basemap comes from Google **or** a self-hosted XYZ server, chosen by config alone.
- **"Latest ref pattern" is intentional**: state lives in `MapEngine`, not React. The
  `ref.current = props` on render, read by a long-lived handler, is deliberate — do not convert
  it into React state.
- **MIL-STD-2525D symbology**: the `@armyc2.c5isr.renderer/mil-sym-ts-web` SDK (~9 MB) is
  **external to the package** — a declared dependency installed alongside it, never inside the
  library's `dist/`, loaded on demand through `import()` the first time a symbol is drawn. It
  never enters the host's initial bundle.

## Quick start

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react'
import { MapProvider, Map, markersLayer, mergeTheme, defaultTheme, imperialMeasure, type MarkerData } from '@pasquelin/map3d'

type Agent = { status: string }

const agents: MarkerData<Agent>[] = [
  {
    id: 'a1',
    type: 'agent-available',
    position: { lat: 48.8566, lng: 2.3522 },
    title: 'Dupont',            // human-readable name: tooltip, lists, SEARCH
    tags: ['user', 'standby'],  // "Layers" filter
    data: { status: 'available' },
  },
]

export function MyMap() {
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string | number>()
  return (
    <MapProvider
      theme={mergeTheme(defaultTheme, { colors: { ui: { accent: '#0af' } } })} // visual identity (a full MapTheme)
      labels={{ measure: imperialMeasure }}            // language and units
      config={{ performance: { antialias: false } }}   // machine, quota, support
    >
      <Map
        center={{ lat: 48.8566, lng: 2.3522 }}
        zoom={14}
        layers={[
          markersLayer<Agent>({
            points: agents,
            cluster: { enabled: true },
            selectedId: selected,
            onSelect: (m) => setSelected(m?.id ?? undefined),
          }),
        ]}
      />
    </MapProvider>
  )
}
```

`markersLayer<Agent>({…})` / `pathsLayer` / `shapesLayer` are the **typed factories**: since
`layers` is heterogeneous, its public type sees `data` as `unknown`; the factory moves the
generic onto the call site (typing `icon`, `menu`, `tooltip`). `<Map>` mounts the UI via the
`toolbar` / `controls` / `search` / `readout` / `dock` / `draw` / `relations` / `layers` props.
`MapHandle` (a `ref` on `<Map>`) frames/draws/queries the map from the outside.

## Guides

- [MARKERS](docs/en/MARKERS.md): points, `MarkerData`, clustering, selection, following, threshold decor, repositioning, dock, performance
- [ZONES](docs/en/ZONES.md): ground-draped zones and shapes, volumetric extrusion, geodesic predicates, framing, paths
- [CATALOG](docs/en/CATALOG.md): remote reference sets — paginated browse sources (aggregates with children, tri-state checkboxes, shapes and markers) **or** viewport-driven toggle sources, persistence
- [DRAWING](docs/en/DRAWING.md): tools, selection, editing, style, history, GeoJSON, CRUD by identity, constraints
- [SYMBOLS](docs/en/SYMBOLS.md): drag-and-drop icon catalog, MIL-STD-2525D symbology
- [TEMPLATES](docs/en/TEMPLATES.md): named drawing saves, local or API storage, sharing, `.m3dt` export
- [RELATIONS](docs/en/RELATIONS.md): tag-based links, real routing distances and durations (Google Routes)
- [LENS](docs/en/LENS.md): lens tool — inventory of the markers within an area
- [SEARCH](docs/en/SEARCH.md): unified search over map elements + place geocoding
- [CAMERA](docs/en/CAMERA.md): initial position, `ready`, flights, `fitBounds` framing, frozen map, basemap
- [PEDESTRIAN](docs/en/PEDESTRIAN.md): pedestrian mode — ground walking, collision, gravity, first-person immersion
- [TILES](docs/en/TILES.md): tile provider — Google or self-hosted server, capabilities and buttons
- [BUILDINGS](docs/en/BUILDINGS.md): selecting a building from the internal volume — tool, `buildingMenu`, surfaced attributes
- [GRATICULE](docs/en/GRATICULE.md): coordinate grid — adaptive mesh, remarkable lines, labels, fade-out on tilt
- [DATA](docs/en/DATA.md): viewport-driven (bbox refetch on move), real-time, tags, pinning, persistence
- [HOOKS](docs/en/HOOKS.md): every React hook, and what re-renders what
- [ENGINE](docs/en/ENGINE.md): engine, events, registries, writing a custom layer
- [PLUGINS](docs/en/PLUGINS.md): plugin author guide — contract, config, data source, pick-time enrichment, hub, registry
- [PREFERENCES](docs/en/PREFERENCES.md): end-user preferences — 3D quality presets, keyboard layout, move/view rebinding, persistence

## Reference (generated from the source types + JSDoc)

- [CONFIG](docs/en/CONFIG.md): `MapConfig` — what you **tune**: providers, gestures, budgets, storage
- [THEME](docs/en/THEME.md): `MapTheme` — what you **see**: colors, sizes, rhythm
- [LABELS](docs/en/LABELS.md): `MapLabels` — every **text string** and formatting rule (units, distances, durations)
- [PROPS](docs/en/PROPS.md): React component props

## Public API — map by domain (every value export of `src/index.ts`, all from `'@pasquelin/map3d'`)

- **React mounting**: `MapProvider`, `Map` (+ `MapHandle` ref, `MapSurfaces` props), typed layer factories `markersLayer` / `pathsLayer` / `shapesLayer` (`LayerSpec`, `MarkersSpec`); layer components for manual placement `MarkerLayer` (+ `MarkerLayerDecl`), `PathLayer`, `ShapeLayer`, `DrawLayer`, `RelationLayer`, `LinkLayer`, `GraticuleLayer`, `LensLayer`, `SymbolMarkers`, `ClusterSurface`; default renderers `DefaultMarker`, `DefaultCluster`; `svgToDataUri` (SVG markup → data URI for icons).
- **Built-in UI** (all mounted by `<Map>`; exported for manual placement): `Toolbar` (+ `useToolbar`, `useCloseWhenHidden`), `MapControls`, `SearchBox`, `CameraReadout`, `PinnedDock`, `TagFilterControl`, `CatalogControl`, `TemplatesPanel` (+ `TemplateThumb`), `PreferencesPanel`, `StatsPanel`, `ContextMenu` (`MenuItem`), `MarkerList`, `LensPanel`, `DrawStylePanel`, `Confirm`, `DraggablePanel`; bar buttons `ToolButton`, `LensToolButton`, `MeasureToolButton`, `DrawSettingsButton`, `SymbolPaletteButton`; atoms `SelectionBadges`, `RelationStatusBar`, `Swatch`, `RemoveButton` (+ `REMOVE_ICON_PATH`).
- **Hooks**: context `useMap`, `useTheme`, `useLabels`, `useConfig`; camera `useCamera` / `useCameraCommands`, `useViewport`, `useZoomGate`, `useMapEvents`; data `useLiveData`, `useTags` / `useTagSelection`; tools `useDrawing`, `useDrawSettings`, `useLens`, `usePedestrian`, `useGraticule`, `useRelations`, `useCapture`; catalog `useCatalog` / `useCatalogSettings` / `useCatalogToggle` / `useCatalogClear` / `useCatalogSourceCount` / `useCatalogSources` / `useCatalogSource`; plugins `usePlugins`, `useBuildingEnrichment`; `useTemplates`; `usePreferences`; drag `useDraggable` / `useDropZone` / `useMapDropZone` / `useRepositionable` / `useDraggablePanel`.
- **Core (no React)**: `MapEngine` (`WHEEL_SURFACE_ATTR` marks a host overlay whose wheel zooms the map), `Camera`, `Projection`, `EnuFrame`, `MapMath` (namespace), `altitudeForZoom` / `zoomForAltitude`, constants `CAMERA_FOV` / `TILE_SIZE`; bounds `boundsOfLatLngs`, `boundsOfCircle`, `boundsOfShape` / `boundsOfShapes`, `boundsOfMarkers`, `boundsAround`, `boundsContains`, `unionBounds`, `centerOfBounds`, `lngSpanDeg`, `altitudeForBounds`; registries `SelectableRegistry` (`SELECTABLE_KINDS`, `kindAllowed`), `ErasableRegistry`, `DragRegistry`, `MarkerRegistry`, `CounterRegistry`, `SearchRegistry`, `AnchorHeightCache`, `ClusterEngine`; `setGeometryWarner` (route non-finite geometry warnings to the host log, or `null`); `VERSION`.
- **Data**: types `Viewport`, `DataSource`, `MarkerData`, `StaticMarker`; `ViewportController`, `diffById`; tag helpers `tagColor`, `countTags`, `markerColorOf`, `tagColorOf`.
- **Config / theme / labels**: `defaultConfig`, `mergeConfig`, `resolveLocale` / `resolveRegion`; `defaultTheme`, `mergeTheme`, `themeToVars`, `configToVars`, `tilesFilterCss`, `injectStyles`; `defaultLabels`, `mergeLabels`, `imperialMeasure`, `formatLabel`, `formatCount`, `symbolText`, formatters `makeDistanceFormatter` / `makeDurationFormatter` / `makeLinkLabelFormatter` / `makeReadoutFormatter` / `makeStatFormatter` (+ `statLabel`, `statLevel`, `isCameraField`); quality `detectDeviceCaps`, `detectQuality`, `qualityPreset`; preferences `defaultPreferences`, `preferencesToPartialConfig`, `usePreferences`; network `fetchWithPolicy` (`FetchPolicy`), `HttpError`, `defaultPluginFetchPolicy`.
- **Drawing / geodesy**: types `DrawTool`, `Drawing`, `DrawnShape`, `NewShape`, `ShapePatch`, `GeoJSONFeatureCollection`, `DrawConstraints`; `DrawSettings`, `DEFAULT_DRAW_PRESETS` (`DrawPresets`), `maxRadiusOf`; eraser `EraseMode` / `EraseResult` / `EraseTarget` (`<DrawLayer onErase>`, `config.erase.targets`, host `erasable` on `PathData`/`ShapeData`); drawing bar `DrawToolbarConfig` / `DrawToolbarAutoHide` (`config.toolbar.minZoom`, `config.toolbar.autoHide.erase` / `.history` — the eraser and its “Clear all” row, and the undo/redo arrows, withdraw when they have nothing to act on, `useDrawing().canErase`; `clear()` shares the eraser's scope, host objects included); geodesic predicates `pointInRing`, `polygonAreaM2`, `circleRing`, `ringInsideRing`, `ringsOverlap`, `ringOfShape`, `predicateSegments` (`PREDICATE_CIRCLE_SEGMENTS`); material constants `DEFAULT_STROKE_OPACITY` / `MEASURE_STROKE_OPACITY`.
- **Selection**: homogeneous selection of markers / paths / clusters with a per-kind policy (`config.selection`, `SelectionConfig`), `SELECTABLE_KINDS` / `kindAllowed`, types `SelectableKind` / `SelectablePolicy` / `SelectableGeometry` / `PolyGeometry` / `SelectableGroup`; single union silhouette (marching-ants) across all kinds via `SelectableRegistry`; `<DrawLayer onSelectionChange>`.
- **Symbols**: `MILSYM_CATALOG`, `MILSYM_ENTRIES`, `MILSYM_AFFILIATION_COLORS`, `createMilSymRenderer`, `milSymSidc`, `applyAffiliation`, `SymbolPaletteButton`, `SYMBOL_DRAG_TYPE` (drag payload type of a palette icon).
- **Search / catalog**: `SearchRegistry` (+ `markerGroupId`, groups `SHAPE_GROUP` / `DRAW_GROUP` / `PLACE_GROUP`), `createGooglePlacesSearch`, matching `normalizeSearch`, `scoreMatch`, `proximityRank`, `rankHits`, `NO_MATCH`, `createTitleCache`; catalog `CatalogRegistry`, `catalogKey` / `parseCatalogKey`, `isBrowseSource` / `isToggleSource`, `categoryOf`, `filterByCategories`, `mergeCollections`, `statsOf`, `CatalogBrowseSource.checkable` (`false` = index mode: no checkbox, the name frames — for a reference set the host paints itself).
- **Relations / routing**: `RelationEngine`, `selectTargets`, `matchesSelector`, `familyTag`, `buildRelationMenu`, `createGoogleRoutesProvider`, `haversineMeters`, `bearingDeg`, `greatCirclePoints`, `fanLegs`, `decodePolyline`, `RouteCache`.
- **Plugins / templates**: `definePlugin`, `PluginRegistry`, `PluginEnrichment`, `PersistedVersionedStore` (shared base of the persisted registries), `TemplateRegistry`, `createHttpTemplateProvider`, `captureView` / `applyView`.
- **Tiles / basemap**: `createTileSource`, `InternalTileSource`, `GoogleTileSource`, `deriveBasemapCapabilities` (`BasemapSupport`), `canEnterMode`.
- **Capture**: `engine.capture(opts)` / `MapHandle.capture` / `useCapture()` → `Promise<Blob>` (synchronous WebGL render + optional DOM-overlay compositing via an injected `rasterizeOverlay`); `<Map capture>` (`CaptureProps`), `config.capture` (`CaptureConfig`), types `CaptureOptions` / `CaptureFormat` / `CaptureBackground` / `OverlayRasterizer`. UI: "Take a photo" row in the ⚙ menu (download / mail / Web Share).
- **Watermark**: "map3D" signature painted into the canvas + licence link, `config.watermark` (`WatermarkConfig`, `enabled` default `true`). Disabling requires a commercial licence — removing attribution under the default PolyForm-Noncommercial licence violates it.

## Codebase conventions (when contributing)

- `docs/` is **bilingual**: any API change updates FR **and** EN in the same move. Reference docs are generated from the types (do not hand-edit the FR side).
- Prettier style: no `;`, single quotes, `printWidth: 120`, `trailingComma: all`.
- `any` is **forbidden**; `tsconfig` is strict + `noUncheckedIndexedAccess`. Use `type`, never `interface`.
- Nothing hard-coded: every behavior/color/label/threshold goes through `config` / `theme` / `labels` or a prop.
- Colocated `*.test.ts` tests (vitest, jsdom). Commands: `pnpm build`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm dev:example`.
